scenario: a notes app tracking activation and weekly retention
title: Did the treatment move the conversion rate?
prompt: You ran an A/B test on a notes app tracking activation and weekly retention.
The treatment changed the primary call-to-action; the control kept the existing flow.
Control converted **1,947 of 13,039** users (14.93%); treatment converted **2,100 of 13,039** (16.11%).
Compute the two-proportion **z statistic** and its two-sided **p-value**, and be ready to state the absolute/relative lift and whether you'd ship.
